image_description: A street scene featuring two prominent signs mounted on a dark vertical post against a white building facade. The left sign is a colorful, artistic poster with abstract shapes and text in Hebrew and English ('CIRCUS'). The right sign is a standard rectangular white street name sign with black Hebrew text and numbers. A smaller red and white sticker/sign is visible lower down on the wall.
